{"code": "import pandas as pd

# Load the data
df = pd.read_csv('data/trial.csv')

# Check for duplicates in patient_id
print(f'Duplicate patient_id count: {df.duplicated(subset="patient_id").sum()}')

# Check for sentinel values in biomarker_baseline
print(f'Number of -999 in biomarker_baseline: {(df["biomarker_baseline"] == -999).sum()}')

# Check for sample_seq duplicates
print(f'Number of patients with multiple sample_seq: {(df.groupby("patient_id")["sample_seq"].nunique() > 1).sum()}')

# Check assay_batch unit error
print(f'Unique assay_batch values: {df["assay_batch"].unique()}')

# Summary of data
print(f'Data shape: {df.shape}')"}
